about: A 12 in digital height gauge on an 18 x 12 x 3 in black granite plate, with the part it is checking, modelled from scratch where the placeholder has each: a cast base (grey enamel over a ground steel sole) with the beam's boss, a stainless beam, a satin slider wrapping it, the display unit (LCD reading 6.5000 in, the scriber's height above the plate; ON/OFF, ZERO and IN/MM keys), the knurled fine-feed wheel and lock knob, a clamped scriber with its carbide tip; the plate lapped on top, honed on its sides, edges radiused; the part a milled aluminium block.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: draft; layout and sizes checked against the placeholder
